title: Import local browser files
boundary: Explicitly select Claude Code or Codex files, a product directory, or a versioned backup available to this browser. Only supplied bytes are uploaded. No browser/target home, system authentication or keyring is read, and selected content is never executed. Ready is not Imported.
directoryHelp: Select the .claude or .codex product directory itself. Only its explicitly selected top-level name is removed; relative hierarchy remains. Browsers without a directory picker can use files or a versioned backup.
packageHelp: Only the inert KCMBNDL1 byte container is supported. Its manifest is read before chunked upload; Native verifies all file sizes and hashes. Arbitrary ZIP files or scripts are not extracted or executed.
filesHelp: Select configuration files directly. Use a product directory or versioned backup to preserve skill/project-history hierarchy. Up to 1024 files and 2 GiB total; originals stay unchanged.
progress: Native received {{received}} / {{total}} bytes and verified {{verified}} bytes
unknown: The latest reply is unconfirmed. The last observation is retained; read the original receipt first. Nothing is resent automatically.
readyBoundary: The bytes have arrived and been verified. No settings, assets or history have been imported. Inspect the content, preview it and explicitly confirm the normal migration plan next.
records: Upload identities saved by this browser
recordsBoundary: This recovery index is scoped to the selected target and account. It is not a server task list or a success receipt. Reading an entry observes the original operation only; resume requires reselecting the same files. Closing does not resend or clean up server data.

stages.failed: Receipt or verification failed; original operation retained

workers.stopped: No verification owner is currently observed; this does not mean Imported.
workers.unknown: Native execution state is unknown. Explicitly read to reconcile.

errors.selectionMismatch: The product, paths, sizes or hashes differ from the original operation. Nothing resumed. Reselect the same files.
errors.recoveryUnavailable: The original operation identity cannot be retained or read reliably. No new upload/control request was sent.
errors.recoveryLimit: This browser’s recovery index is full. Reconcile existing operations first.
errors.outcomeUnknown: The upload/control outcome is unconfirmed. Read its original receipt before explicitly resuming.
errors.selectionFailed: The format, relative paths or size are unsupported. No new upload started.
errors.localStopped: Local reading stopped. No Native upload operation was created.
errors.migration_source_upload_update_required: Upgrade this runtime target to receive browser files. No other target was selected automatically.
errors.productUnknown: The preparation reply is unconfirmed. Read its original state first. Retry/resume keeps the original operation and never runs automatically.
errors.noSafeFiles: The selected directory has no receivable files. Excluded bodies were not read.
errors.rawFileCount: The raw file count exceeds the bounded inspection limit. Explicitly choose a smaller product directory or file set.

useUnavailable: This target does not yet provide an uploaded-source adoption entry. The original upload receipt is retained and can be read again. Nothing falls back to the target home or treats Ready as Imported.

product.title: Prepare uploaded files for inspection
product.boundary: This preparation step is separate from upload and has its own cancellation and resume state. It only prepares confirmed received bytes. No target settings are published, source tools executed or other home directories scanned.
product.ready: The bytes are ready for static inspection. They are user-supplied files, not proof of an original machine/account identity or a completed import. Explicitly choose content and confirm the normal migration preview next.

stages.failed: Source preparation incomplete; check original state

userSupplied: These files were explicitly supplied by the user and do not grant original-device or system-account identity.
excludedBoundary: These entries were excluded before reading or hashing their bodies and will not be uploaded. This does not sanitize private values inside retained files.
excludedPrivate: Excluded {{count}} authentication, key, environment or private system entries.
excludedCache: Excluded {{count}} repository, dependency or runtime-cache entries.
